title: 6.7220J Nonlinear Optimization

notes: Prerequisites are substantial: linear algebra plus real analysis. No credential or interactive completion route is claimed at Discovery; classify conservatively as F2 pending Shallow Screening.

title: 12.340x Global Warming Science
reason: Full undergraduate climate-science course covering energy balance, greenhouse gases, atmospheric and ocean circulation, aerosols, palaeoclimate evidence and climate modelling, with lectures, problem sets and exams; it is a serious candidate for the explicit climate-science gap.
notes: The course was taught in Spring 2020 and remains available through MIT OpenCourseWare/Open Learning Library. Shallow Screening must decide whether the age is acceptable for a climate-science anchor and verify the current assessment mechanics.

title: BUS633: Sales Management
